source_game: Ragnarok Online — Japanese client (GungHo Online Entertainment), classic-era windowed UI
note: Video frames are primary evidence. GungHo play-manual screenshots are marked secondary. roBrowser source (https://github.com/vthibault/roBrowser) is cited in docs/research/ro-behaviour-cards.md as secondary evidence only; no roBrowser file is copied here.

frames.video_title: ラグナロクオンライン　スタートアップガイド(ウィンドウ編 その３)
frames.shows: サウンド設定: BGM and SOUND sliders. Each is ◁ decrement arrow, a sunken horizontal track, a round blue thumb, ▷ increment arrow, then an on checkbox. Thumbs sit at different positions, so the thumb position is the value.
frames.licence: Private study. Frame grabbed from a publicly published video for non-commercial research into UI behaviour; not redistributed as media. Ragnarok Online (C) Gravity Co., Ltd. & Lee Myoungjin / GungHo Online Entertainment.

frames.video_title: ラグナロクオンライン　スタートアップガイド(ウィンドウ編 その３)
frames.shows: グラフィック設定: スプライト解像度 and テクスチャ解像度 sliders with both thumbs clamped hard against the right (maximum) end — the thumb does not overrun the arrow button.
